نَصْرٌ [used a subst.,] Aid or assistance, rendered to another, especially against an enemy: [avengement or another:] victory or conquest: (Bd, xxix. 9:) and ↓ نُصْرَةٌ is a subst. from نَصَرَهُ [and therefore signifies the same]: (S, Msb:) or the ↓ latter signifies good aid, or assistance: (M, K:) and this ↓ same word, when the object is God, signifies aid of God's servants; &c.; as explained above: see 1. (El-Basáïr.) ―
-b2- Spoil; plunder; booty. (Bd, ubi supra.) ―
-b3- (tropical:) Rain; (A, TA;) as also ↓ نُصْرَةٌ : (TA:) in like manner as it is called فَتْح: (A, TA:) or the ↓ latter signifies a complete rain. (IAar.) ―
-b4- [Hence,] (tropical:) A gift: (S, TA:) and نَصَائِرُ gifts. (M.) ―
-b5- See also نَاصِرٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
